patterns.note: Full-bleed immersive photography and video backgrounds are used extensively for hero sections and major content blocks, creating a highly visual and aspirational experience.
The site primarily uses a dark theme with black backgrounds and white text, interspersed with occasional light grey sections for visual rhythm and content separation.

A sophisticated, elegant serif display font is used for primary headings and brand elements, creating a luxurious feel, contrasted with a clean, modern sans-serif for body text and functional elements.

A multi-stage hero transition system reveals different full-bleed visual experiences as the user scrolls, starting with a brand statement, then a booking interface, before settling into the main content.
A compact sticky header with the brand logo and menu icon appears and condenses after scrolling past the initial hero content, providing persistent navigation.
Destination and experience cards are presented in dynamic, often horizontally scrollable or grid layouts, featuring large imagery and concise descriptive text.

technique_notes: The site employs a multi-stage scroll-triggered hero transition, where an initial full-bleed video hero fades or slides out to reveal a second full-bleed video hero with interactive elements, before transitioning to the main content. This is likely orchestrated using a scroll animation library, combined with `video-hero` elements for the backgrounds and potentially `lottie` for subtle animated details.
Full-bleed immersive photography and video are used extensively as section backgrounds, often with subtle dark overlays to ensure text legibility and maintain a sophisticated aesthetic.
A compact sticky header is revealed after scrolling past the initial hero, providing persistent navigation that is less intrusive than the initial full header.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, elegant serif display headings (~4-5x body) with smaller, uppercase sans-serif labels and clear, readable sans-serif body text.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners for most elements, subtle rounding on buttons and interactive cards.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy in hero sections and between major content blocks, balanced within content grids and text blocks.

standout: The site's distinctive design lies in its sophisticated, multi-stage scroll-triggered hero experience that seamlessly transitions between different full-bleed video and image presentations. This, combined with a predominantly dark theme and elegant typography, creates an exceptionally luxurious and immersive brand narrative that feels more like an editorial experience than a typical booking site.
